Show less Read more Like 4 Dislike Reply @barbaraberry1064 7 days ago 🇺🇸 What Democrats want Led by figures like Hakeem Jeffries and Chuck Schumer: 1. Reopen government first • Pass a “clean” funding bill (no controversial add-ons) • Get agencies like TSA, FEMA, Coast Guard running normally again 2. Handle immigration separately • Debate border policy later, as its own issue • Avoid tying paychecks and airport security to immigration fights 3. Protect current immigration system • Generally oppose stricter enforcement measures being demanded right now • Want changes (if any) to be negotiated more gradually Their argument: “Don’t hold TSA workers’ pay and air travel hostage over unrelated political demands.” ⸻ 🇺🇸 What Republicans want Backed by leaders like Mike Johnson and supported by Donald Trump: 1. Tie funding to border security • Any bill reopening the Department of Homeland Security must include: • Tougher asylum rules • Increased detention and deportation powers • Limits on how migrants are released into the U.S. 2. Use the shutdown as leverage • They see this as a moment to force major immigration changes • Don’t want to pass a temporary fix without those changes 3. Full-agency funding only • Prefer funding the entire DHS at once • Oppose piecemeal funding (like just TSA) Their argument: “Fix the border crisis now — not later — or the problem just continues.” Show less Read more Like 2 Dislike Reply @ameliaFz69 7 days ago They need to send the money to TSA and tell Trump no money for his clowns.
